name: s81dv_idxrg

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: dsdv_idx_rg lands every input in a flop at the pin and drives every output from a flop (header 'Pins'); the 2-edge chain hops (qi->qo, si->so) and the +1 station register on rq/rd are the priced static schedule, a recipe pin stage would shift every compiled beat.

structural_change: S81-IDXRD (MU.BAL.SX.3, release blocker): NEW element. p4l (bind9) has no index reader/scorer; this is the regional reader x16 (one per dsfd_ctrl_rg2 region), a station on the region's rq/rd link, exact engine ot_hdc_v41x_idx_engine NK 1, selector-native BK beats on a neighbour-only score chain into dsdv_bk_sel.

job.purpose: S81-DV p4l regional index reader/scorer dsdv_idx_rg (x16 a die, MU.BAL.SX.3 release blocker) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

why_floorplan: Region pair column of the p4l svc grid is 1,062.5 um wide (2 x the 531.25 um dsfd_ctrl_rg2 pitch): one reader a region, two stacked a column (A over rg2 2c, B over A for rg2 2c+1, B's rq/rd lanes over A on die layers M6/M7 with landed relays). N face = svc_rs side (rqi, rdo), S face = rg2 side (rqo, rdi), W/E = the neighbour-only query / score chains. First gate sizes the outline from the synthesized area (util 0.52).
